newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian prime minister to be back at work Friday.
newsitem.headline: Russian prime minister to be back at work Friday.

text.p: Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin will return to work on Friday after a week's holiday near Moscow, Itar-Tass news agency said on Tuesday.
Chernomyrdin's aides were not available for comment.

Tass quoted his spokesman, Viktor Konnov, as saying the prime minister would attend a summit of heads of government from the 12 former Soviet republics in the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS) in Moscow on Friday.
First deputy prime minister Alexei Bolshakov will chair Thursday's cabinet meeting.

Chernomyrdin, who is President Boris Yeltsin's constitutional deputy, left for his holiday a day after the Kremlin leader was taken into hospital with pneumonia last Wednesday. The two men have kept in telephone contact.
